findings.title: Concurrent transitions are check-then-write races

evidence.detail: Version is read before unconditional update.
Reconciliation updates after separate candidate calculation.
Reversal check precedes writes without uniqueness.

findings.impact: Concurrent instances can accept stale edits, change reconciliation sets, or create multiple reversals.
findings.remediation: Begin immediate transactions and use predicates/constraints.

findings.title: Import and reconciliation errors lose operation identity

evidence.detail: Import validation omits operation_id before normalization.
SQLite and CSV errors escape normalization.

findings.impact: Stable-code and exact operation_id guarantees fail.
findings.remediation: Pass operation_id and translate CSV/SQLite errors.

findings.title: Closing a period permanently prevents later reversal

evidence.detail: Original closed date rejects an open-date reversal.

findings.impact: Historical reconciled transactions cannot be corrected.
findings.remediation: Enforce closure only on reversal date.

report.security_posture: Bound SQL and no secrets; import ceilings unspecified.
report.strongest_quality: SQLite transactions colocate state and audit writes.
report.weakest_quality: Invariants are non-atomic and failures are inconsistently normalized.

evidence.detail: One method per transition but competing outcomes possible.
Shared closure checks but transaction semantics are scattered.
Tests omit concurrency and storage faults.
Reconciliation write can diverge from calculation.

overall_readiness.rationale: Atomicity and contract defects block production.

take_production_ownership.rationale: Small and inspectable after correctness hardening.

test_confidence.supplied: Five tests establish core sequential behavior.

denial_of_service.detail: No trusted-input or maximum-size requirement is defined.

operations.detail: Locking and operational errors are unsafe.

settings.tools: read candidate; run only supplied sandbox command
